query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('album',to_jsonb(a),'photos',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'short_id',p.short_id,'title',p.title,'visibility',p.visibility,'kind',p.kind,'is_hdr',p.is_hdr,'status',p.status,'deleted_at',p.deleted_at,'preview',(SELECT '/i/'||d.hash||'/'||d.variant||'.'||d.format FROM derivatives d WHERE d.photo_id=p.id AND NOT hdr ORDER BY (variant='thumb') DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY p.sort_order,p.id),'[]') FROM photos p WHERE p.album_id=a.id)) AS "page!" FROM albums a WHERE id=$1
